content.json:
## tenant-pulse activity

What the simulator has actually done in the demo tenant, read from the activity events the container writes to stdout and Log Analytics collects.

The Azure Table journal remains the system of record and holds the purge paths, but it sits behind a private endpoint. This view is readable from any browser with RBAC on the workspace.

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where ContainerAppName_s == '__APP_NAME__'
| where Log_s contains 'tenant-pulse-activity'
| extend _brace = indexof(Log_s, '{')
| where _brace >= 0
| extend e = parse_json(substring(Log_s, _brace))
| extend Outcome = tostring(e.outcome)
| where Outcome in ({Outcome}) or '*' in ({Outcome})
| summarize Activities = count() by Outcome
| order by Activities desc
content.title: Outcomes

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where ContainerAppName_s == '__APP_NAME__'
| where Log_s contains 'tenant-pulse-activity'
| extend _brace = indexof(Log_s, '{')
| where _brace >= 0
| extend e = parse_json(substring(Log_s, _brace))
| extend Outcome = tostring(e.outcome)
| where Outcome in ({Outcome}) or '*' in ({Outcome})
| summarize Activities = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), Outcome
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Activity over time

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where ContainerAppName_s == '__APP_NAME__'
| where Log_s contains 'tenant-pulse-activity'
| extend _brace = indexof(Log_s, '{')
| where _brace >= 0
| extend e = parse_json(substring(Log_s, _brace))
| extend Outcome = tostring(e.outcome), Kind = tostring(e.kind), Workload = tostring(e.workload)
| where Outcome in ({Outcome}) or '*' in ({Outcome})
| summarize Activities = count() by Workload, Kind
| order by Activities desc
content.title: By workload and activity kind

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where ContainerAppName_s == '__APP_NAME__'
| where Log_s contains 'tenant-pulse-activity'
| extend _brace = indexof(Log_s, '{')
| where _brace >= 0
| extend e = parse_json(substring(Log_s, _brace))
| extend Outcome = tostring(e.outcome), Persona = tostring(e.actor), Upn = tostring(e.upn), Department = tostring(e.dept)
| summarize Total = count(), Executed = countif(Outcome == 'Executed'), Skipped = countif(Outcome == 'Skipped'), Failed = countif(Outcome == 'Failed') by Persona, Department, Upn
| order by Total desc
content.title: By persona

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where ContainerAppName_s == '__APP_NAME__'
| where Log_s contains 'tenant-pulse-activity'
| extend _brace = indexof(Log_s, '{')
| where _brace >= 0
| extend e = parse_json(substring(Log_s, _brace))
| extend Outcome = tostring(e.outcome)
| where Outcome in ({Outcome}) or '*' in ({Outcome})
| project TimeGenerated, Outcome, Kind = tostring(e.kind), Persona = tostring(e.actor), Topic = tostring(e.topic), Detail = tostring(e.detail), Storyline = tostring(e.storyline), Link = tostring(e.link)
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 250
content.title: Everything done, most recent first

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where ContainerAppName_s == '__APP_NAME__'
| where Log_s contains 'tenant-pulse-activity'
| extend _brace = indexof(Log_s, '{')
| where _brace >= 0
| extend e = parse_json(substring(Log_s, _brace))
| where tostring(e.outcome) == 'Failed'
| project TimeGenerated, Kind = tostring(e.kind), Persona = tostring(e.actor), Topic = tostring(e.topic), Error = tostring(e.error)
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100
content.title: Failures

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where ContainerAppName_s == '__APP_NAME__'
| where Log_s contains 'falling back to templates' or Log_s contains 'Planned' or Log_s contains 'Unhandled'
| project TimeGenerated, Log_s
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100
content.title: Engine health (planning, content fallback, crashes)
